verdict.rationale: Secureframe's vendor risk management module covers the core of the story. It keeps the vendor inventory current by detecting shadow-IT apps via SSO, monitors vendor security posture, and uses Comply AI to pull answers from vendor SOC 2 reports and policies. It also sets recurring reviews by risk level, with Jira and Slack tasks and vendor-update notifications. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of tracking each vendor's data access or data classification, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
